name: Katowice
registryBasis: The City of Katowice’s geospatial portal describes the EGiB (land/building register) parcel layer and publishes city WMS/WFS services. The published parcel feature layer exposes anonymous GeoJSON polygon queries. Its exact ranked WUP-point and nearby bounded queries returned no features, while a separate central-city query returned two safe-ID polygons; this proves some city layer geometry is retrievable but not coverage at the WUP point.

verifiedParcelResponse.requestFilter: One 1000 m × 1000 m EPSG:2177 envelope centered at [6572839.5,5564574.5] in central Katowice. Separate exact WUP-point, nearby 1000 m × 1000 m and 2000 m × 2000 m queries returned empty collections.
verifiedParcelResponse.limitations: The returned polygons are from a bounded central-city area and do not contain or correspond to the WUP point. The service set exceededTransferLimit=true despite returning two features, so no completeness claim is made. Only safe parcel ID and geometry were retained; no owner/address fields were requested or saved.

queries.query: Katowice oficjalna mapa działek ewidencyjnych ewidencja gruntów geoportal EGiB WFS
queries.scope: Locate official local EGiB/cadastral parcel services and test safe public polygon geometry near the ranked point.
queries.result: The official Katowice spatial-information portal describes EGiB parcels, provides WMS/WFS service links, and its ArcGIS layer metadata exposes a polygon Działki layer in EPSG:2177 with GeoJSON query support and native field IDENT_DZ. The ranked WUP point query and two nearby envelopes returned no features. A separate central-city envelope returned two safe-ID parcel polygons; those samples do not cover the WUP point.
queries.executionMethod: Separate Polish-language search followed by review of official city portal and layer metadata; anonymous point and bounded service queries requested only parcel identifiers plus geometry.

queries.query: Katowice Poland official cadastral parcel GIS EGiB WFS map
queries.scope: Locate official local EGiB/cadastral parcel services and test safe public polygon geometry near the ranked point.
queries.result: GUGIK’s official EGiB service page explains that the register includes land/parcel data and that county WFS downloads can provide parcel geometries. Katowice’s official portal publishes its city EGiB service. The exact WUP point query returned no polygon; two central-city safe-ID samples confirm polygon geometry is retrievable elsewhere in the layer, subject to root qualification.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language search followed by review of GUGIK and official Katowice sources; bounded anonymous requests retained only safe parcel identifiers and geometry.

scopeLimits: Only two polygons were retained from the bounded central Katowice envelope. The exact ranked WUP point and two local neighboring envelopes returned no features; whether this reflects point location or service behavior remains uncertain. A WUP settlement centroid is not a parcel identity. The EGiB service’s citywide completeness, attribute release suitability, title accuracy and stable identifier lifecycle are not qualified here.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.

source.name: Katowice EGiB Działki parcel layer
source.operator: City of Katowice / Katowicka Infrastruktura Informacji Przestrzennej
source.serviceType: ArcGIS REST Feature Layer with anonymous bounded GeoJSON query; separate WFS service is also published
source.outputCrs: EPSG:2177 native; sample transformed locally to EPSG:4326
source.nativeIdEvidence: Official REST layer metadata lists IDENT_DZ as a string field (length 36); returned sample values are preserved unchanged.

technicalBlocker: Official REST GeoJSON and Esri JSON claim EPSG:4326 while returning coordinate values in native EPSG:2177 (for example x=6573053.29,y=5565132.756). Root reproduced this with two bounded Esri JSON queries: the ranked viewport is empty and the central sample returns two native-coordinate polygons under a false 4326 spatialReference, with exceededTransferLimit=true. The current runtime correctly rejects these unsupported coordinates. A truthful native CRS transport and complete enumeration/exact-ID contract remain unqualified; centroid containment is not the hold reason.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the ranked point falls outside the city parcel layer or the feature service has a query/coverage limitation there; citywide layer completeness and adapter behavior are not proven.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Two sampled central-city parcel polygons only; no WUP-point coverage verified.
